verdict.rationale: CLAUDE.md is explicitly documented as a project-root markdown file Claude Code reads at the start of every session, used to set coding standards, architecture decisions, preferred libraries, and review checklists—directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of its effectiveness beyond first-party docs (one community note mentions CLAUDE.md files 'exploding' with guardrails, but this doesn't dispute the feature's existence or basic function).
